svg.text: Kill the leader, verify the new election, the writes that follow and the rejoin

g.text: seed 20 users, assert on all three

kill right after a write; only
3 ArcadeDB containers on one Docker network, all given the same Raft server list.
All containers start in parallel; Testcontainers waits for each node's HTTP health probe.
Every node's cluster endpoint is polled once a second until one of them claims leadership.
GET /api/v1/cluster -> body contains "isLeader":true (the run fails after 60s)
Database and schema are written through the leader, which Raft carries to every follower.
CREATE VERTEX TYPE User, Photo - EDGE TYPE HasUploaded, FriendOf, Likes - UNIQUE_HASH / FULL_TEXT / GEOSPATIAL
A known starting point on every node, asserted directly rather than awaited.
The leader is located and its container is stopped outright - a catastrophic failure, not a graceful shutdown.
The two remaining nodes still hold a majority of three, so Raft elects a new leader from them.
Writes resume on the majority. The count is measured, not assumed: writes issued during the transition may be lost.
The two survivors must agree, and must not have gone backwards below the pre-failover count.
until(usersS1 == usersS2 && usersS1 >= 20L) atMost 60s - then assert survivor2 == convergedCount
The killed node is restarted and must reach exactly the converged count via Raft log catch-up.
containers[leaderIdx].start(); waitForContainerHealthy(60); new ServerWrapper(...) - the mapped port changed
After the rejoin all three nodes are asserted against the same converged count.
